Off-peak tickets will be accepted on all trains.
Special schedules will also be in effect on the Hudson Rail Link, Haverstraw-Ossining Ferry, and Newburgh-Beacon Ferry.
Plan your trip on the TrainTime app or at mta.info/schedules.

alerts.title: The Port Jervis Line runs on a weekend schedule on the day after Thanksgiving, with three extra trains
alerts.body:
Two extra inbound trains depart Port Jervis at 6:18am and 4:05pm, arriving Hoboken at 8:30am and 6:24pm respectively.
One extra outbound train departs Hoboken at 5:19pm.
These trains make all stops between Port Jervis and Suffern, then run to or from Secaucus Junction and Hoboken.
